shared_elements: upright slab/stele-shaped surface with carved decoration on one face
circular or ring-shaped motif in the upper part of the composition
elongated vertical element occupying the lower part
bilateral symmetry about a vertical axis
justification:
The only real correspondence is generic: both are upright carved slabs with a roughly circular motif high on the face and a tapering vertical element below, arranged symmetrically about a central axis. Otherwise the content is entirely different 
s A depicts an anthropomorphic figure with a face, headdress, arms and scattered emblematic discs and bands in modelled relief, while B shows a purely abstract, geometrically constructed interlace of continuous ribbons above an anchor-like stem, with no figural reference at all.
